en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from one of our companions who said,

‘Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> the 3rd said to one of his<sup>asws</sup> workers: ‘Frequent for us from the aubergines, for it is hot during the time of heat, and cool in the times of coldness, being moderate in all of the times, good upon every state’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from certain persons of our people who have said the following: “

Abu al-Hassan, al-Thalith, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, would say to certain ones of his workers, ‘Bring more eggplant for us because it is warm in hot season and it is cool in cold season and it is balanced in all seasons. It is fine in all conditions/”
